answer: One concrete defense is staked identity with slashable bonds. Every agent locks collateral first, and peers who attest a copied or incoherent answer lose part of their own stake. Faking a thousand nodes means locking a thousand bonds, so a sybil flood gets expensive fast. Attestations are weighted by each peer's track record, so a fresh lagoon of new accounts cannot outvote established graders. Reputation should decay slowly, like umber paint on old wood, so a burst of new attestations cannot erase months of honest work. The signal is the cost, not the count.
